customer_outcome: The cradle and front-top rings attract in their assembled orientation, with pole identity preserved across separate paused insertions.
user_observation_quote: I really need some way to keep track of magnet orientation. I've no idea if the magnet I just inserted is going to be flipped the correct direction to mate with the one I inserted earlier this morning.
fit_label_scope: C3 identifies cavity fit; it does not identify a pole or a physically marked ring.

reference_ring.dot_definition: The reference-ring flat face that attracts the current front-top mating face; the opposite reference face must repel at the same centered position.

marking_convention.mark_same_pole_by: Mark the candidate ring face that repels MASTER dot-to-dot with centers aligned and both rings held against turning over.
marking_convention.cradle_dot_faces: Toward the thin mating cover and front top.
marking_convention.front_top_dot_faces: Toward backing, away from the cradle.

parts.tracking_id_scope: Record identity; physical label application is unverified.
parts.insertion_report_scope: The current conversation identifies the recently inserted ring as the Mark2 cradle mate of the front-top ring inserted earlier that morning; it does not identify either pole.

parts.tracking_id_scope: Record identity; physical label application is unverified.
parts.insertion_report_scope: The current conversation identifies the recently inserted ring as the Mark2 cradle mate of the front-top ring inserted earlier that morning; it does not identify either pole.

pair_verification.acceptance: The fixed reference dot face attracts the front-top mating surface and repels the cradle mating surface, with both responses reversing when the reference ring is turned over. Test through the thin mating covers, face-on and centered on the embedded rings. Unclear responses leave polarity unverified.

scope: Operator-reported insertion and a defined pole-tracking method. The actual installed poles, physical marks and reference calibration have no verification result. No installed retention force, heat exposure, magnet strength or full-assembly acceptance is established.
